Theme

guardian noun

of a child or ward

also legal guardian, trustee

classical

Plaut. Truc. 859: quī suīs tūtōrem mēd optāvit līberīs
Cic. Att. 12.28.3: tūtor sum līberīs (Lewis & Short)

tūtor, tūtōris m.

noun, third declension

the guardian of a child, a woman or anyone not in charge of his own affairs

From tueor. It does not mean a teacher.

Examples

  • Videō eccum quī suīs tūtōrem mēd optāvit līberīs.

    Ah, there I see the man who chose me as guardian for his children.Plaut. Truc. 859

See also orphan, parents, foster child.

SourcesLewis & Short: tutor

Plautus, Truculentus 859.
